newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer names George Long chairman.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer names George Long chairman.

text.p: Oppenheimer Capital said Tuesday that George Long has been named chairman and chief executive to succeed Joseph La Motta, who has been named chairman emeritus.
Long has been the company president since 1996 and will continue in his role as chief investment officer, a post he has held for the past 10 years.
The change has been planned by Oppenheimer Capital for over a year.

In addition to his role as chairman emeritus, La Motta will maintain his relationships with a number of the firm's key clients and will continue as chairman of Oppenheimer Capital Trust Co. He will also continue as chairman of both OCC Cash Reserves and OCC Accumulation Trust, Oppenheimer said.
